svg.title: Single Agent Execution Sequence
svg.desc: A single agent owns the task, loads skill instructions, calls the LLM, executes tools through MCP, reviews observations and returns the result. Transparent canvas, 2.1:1. All text is vector outlines. Requests and replies share a correlation number.

g.aria-label: Agent Loop · Decide → Act → Observe → Continue
Continue with another action, or exit when the task is complete.
